scope: REPRESENTATIVE SUBSET: 3 systems, 2 weight sets, 102 cells, 816 trials. Chosen for time and checkpoint availability, NOT by performance ranking.
not_a_full_benchmark: The initial planned roster had 17 systems; the frozen suite defines 34 cells per system. This subset was chosen for time and availability BEFORE any score was judged, and is not a best-of selection.

raw_authoritative.note: unchanged; the measurement as produced. Lacks top-level n_envs.

derived_extract.repair: adds ONLY top-level n_envs, taken from the frozen cell declaration (Cell.envs=8), after an independent cardinality check that result.n equalled the declared value on every row. 102/102 repaired, 0 refused. No other key added, changed or removed.
derived_extract.why: the runner in force at scoring time did not write top-level n_envs, and report.validate_results requires it.

source_at_scoring_time.verdict: the 102 rows were produced under the declared freeze

source_drift_after_scoring.note: core's closure edited the PRODUCER so future runs emit n_envs. It does not and cannot retroactively add the key to rows already written, which is why the derived extract above exists. Recorded because SOURCE-FREEZE.md declares these files frozen.

excluded.cl_main_estimated_s502@estimated: cancelled partial, 1/34 cells, rc -15; shed by the VRAM guard when nvidia-smi failed mid-run. Preserved on disk, not a result.

returncode_caveat: s501's exit code was never collected: its parent supervisor was terminated before it could reap the child. 34/34 rows and the runner's terminal 'wrote 34 cells' line evidence completion; that is not an observed exit code and is not recorded as one.

published_files.note: Filenames as published in docs/research/. The `path` fields above are the working locations the files were produced at; these are where they live in the repository.
published_files.combined_results_json: benchmark-v1-2026-09-12-results.json — the same 102 cells as a single JSON payload carrying both hashes; it overlaps the two .jsonl files rather than adding data.

report_generated_at_note: when this report was rendered, NOT when the runs were measured

started_then_excluded.cl_main_estimated_s502@estimated: cancelled partial, 1/34 cells, rc -15; shed by the VRAM guard when nvidia-smi failed mid-run. Preserved on disk, not a result.

systems_not_in_this_table.note: 13 never started plus one cancelled one-cell partial = the 14 not reported here
